segments.segment_summary: A man sitting in the bucket of a tractor next to a large compost pile introduces a video about composting chicken manure and his process.

key_moments.caption: A close-up shot of a smiling man in a plaid jacket and baseball cap talking to the camera.
A wide shot shows the man sitting in a tractor bucket next to the compost pile, with a camera on a tripod also in the shot.
The man gestures towards the compost pile while explaining his process.

segments.segment_summary: The words Farm, Marketing, and Solutions appear sequentially on a grey background, followed by the full Farm Marketing Solutions logo featuring a red barn graphic.

key_moments.caption: The word "Farm" appears in black text.
The word "Marketing" appears in black text.
The word "Solutions" appears in black text.
The full "Farm Marketing Solutions" logo is displayed on screen.

segments.segment_summary: The man explains his composting process, showing a timelapse of a tractor cleaning hay and manure from a greenhouse. He then discusses the surprisingly pleasant smell of the compost and his method for turning and monitoring its temperature.

key_moments.caption: The man explains that he cleaned out a greenhouse to create the compost pile.
A timelapse shows a tractor moving hay and manure inside a large greenhouse.
The man says the compost smells great.
He explains his routine of turning the compost every few days and using a thermometer.
He describes his 2-foot long compost thermometer and how it helps him monitor the process.
